t: This is the home of the Royal Society of Painter-Printmakers, a leading art institution in London. It began in 1880 as a society of etchers and received its Royal Charter in 1888. Among its founders were James Tissot, Hubert von Herkomer and Alphonse Legros, who was important as a teacher in the British etching revival. Francis Seymour Haden, a surgeon and passionate etcher, was its first president. Robert Walker Macbeth and Heywood Hardy were founders too. Over time the society widened to include engraving, wood-engraving, lithography and all forms of original printmaking. From April 2026 it is officially the Royal Society of Printmakers.
